name: Afritensor Trade Dossier
description: The decision record of one autonomous trade: the thesis committed before the outcome was known, every gate verdict that admitted or refused it, the execution as filled, the measured outcome, and the on-chain anchors binding all of it. Produced by the Zcastor agent stack; one dossier per resolved signal.
key_questions: What direction did the agent commit to, and when — before or after the outcome was known?
Which gates evaluated this signal, and what did each one decide?
What entry, stop and target did the trade actually receive at the broker?
What was the measured outcome, in R and in dollars?
Which on-chain records attest this trade, and on which chains?
Was this trade a re-entry, and if so which trade does it follow?
